facts.heading: End of marriage decision
facts.content: Jana and Radka have decided to divorce after 15 years of marriage. Jana cannot understand the decision.
facts.evidence: After 15 years of marriage, Radka and I have decided to divorce. And I still can't understand it.

facts.heading: Divorce announcement timing
facts.content: Radka told Jana that it was not possible anymore in September.
facts.evidence: And in September he told me that it's not possible anymore.

facts.heading: Jana's reaction to news
facts.content: Jana sat in the kitchen and could not say anything when told about the divorce.
facts.evidence: I was sitting in the kitchen and couldn't say anything.

facts.heading: Jana's internal feelings
facts.content: Jana experienced emptiness, anger, and emptiness after the divorce news.
facts.evidence: Empty. Then anger. Then again emptiness.

facts.heading: Regret about past actions
facts.content: Jana thinks she should have seen things and feels blind.
facts.evidence: That I should have seen it, that I'm blind.

facts.heading: Jana's self-reflection
facts.content: Jana keeps looking back in her head where she made a mistake.
facts.evidence: I keep looking back in my head where I made a mistake.

facts.heading: Jana's past self-criticism
facts.content: Jana thinks she was too tired and didn't care about things.
facts.evidence: Sometimes I think I was too tired and I didn't care about it.

facts.heading: Jana's past self-criticism 2
facts.content: Jana thought she was too much worried at times.
facts.evidence: Sometimes I thought I was too much worried.

facts.heading: Stress related to children
facts.content: Jana feels suffering mainly because of the children.
facts.evidence: Yes, mainly because of the kids.

facts.heading: Jana's children's ages
facts.content: Jana has two children, Aniška is 12 and Matěj is 8 years old.
facts.evidence: I have two kids. Aniška is 12 and Matěj is 8 years old.

facts.heading: Aniška's question to Jana
facts.content: Last week Aniška asked Jana if they were arguing with Dad.
facts.evidence: Last week she asked me if we were arguing with dad.

facts.heading: Jana lied to Aniška
facts.content: Jana lied to Aniška about arguing with Dad, and Aniška knew.
facts.evidence: I lied to her and she knew. She saw it in my eyes.

facts.heading: Jana's fear regarding Aniška
facts.content: Jana feared she would ruin Aniška's life or take her home.
facts.evidence: That I would ruin her life, that I would take her home.

facts.heading: Jana's hesitation to tell truth
facts.content: Jana is afraid of the children's tears when telling them the truth.
facts.evidence: I'm afraid of their tears.

facts.heading: Jana's plan for Matěj
facts.content: Jana wants to give Matěj the message that they both like him and it doesn't change.
facts.evidence: That we both like him and that it doesn't change.

facts.heading: Jana's uncertainty about future
facts.content: Jana does not know what the future will look like regarding the apartment.
facts.evidence: But I don't know if it's true, when I don't know what it will look like.

facts.heading: Jana's current living arrangement
facts.content: The children will stay with Jana, and the apartment is in the pharmacy.
facts.evidence: The children will stay with me. The apartment is in the pharmacy, Radek is going to his brother, at least so far.

facts.heading: Jana's fear about her ability
facts.content: Jana is afraid she will not be able to manage the new situation.
facts.evidence: I'm afraid I won't be able to do it.

facts.heading: Jana's income source
facts.content: Jana is glad she always managed to earn money.
facts.evidence: I'm glad I always managed to earn money.

facts.heading: Jana's current job
facts.content: Jana works as a Czech teacher at a primary school in Brno.
facts.evidence: I work as a Czech teacher at a primary school in Brno.

facts.heading: Jana's teaching level
facts.content: Jana teaches 9th and 8th graders.
facts.evidence: I teach 9th and 8th graders.

facts.heading: Studying with a child
facts.content: Jana goes to class with a little boy in her lap. Jana feels like everyone sees her life is falling apart.
facts.evidence: I go to class with a little boy in my lap. I feel like everyone sees that my life is falling apart.

facts.heading: Teacher helped Jana
facts.content: Jana told the teacher she cried at a dance. The teacher let her go earlier.
facts.evidence: I told her that because I once cried at the dance. She let me go earlier.

facts.heading: Work made Jana worse
facts.content: Jana was sitting at home and it was worse when she was alone at work.
facts.evidence: But then I was sitting at home and it was worse. Because I was alone at work.

facts.heading: Jana sleeps poorly
facts.content: Jana sleeps badly every night. She wakes up at 3 a.m. and thinks about what's next.
facts.evidence: Every night I wake up at 3 a.m. and think about what's next.

facts.heading: Jana's current situation
facts.content: Jana states she has no mortgage and no husband. She counts money and imagines telling her children.
facts.evidence: I have no mortgage, no husband, nothing. I count the money and imagine how I will tell my children.

facts.heading: Jana's weight loss
facts.content: Jana does not eat much and has lost 4 kilos.
facts.evidence: I don't eat much. I lost 4 kilos.

facts.heading: Friend Eva's behavior
facts.content: Jana's friend Eva wants almost everything. Eva wants Jana to have a hard time and does not want Jana to think about anything.
facts.evidence: Eva just wants me to have a hard time. She doesn't want me to think about anything.

facts.heading: Fear about lying
facts.content: Jana is afraid that she lied. She is afraid a woman who cannot keep a marriage is not a good example for children.
facts.evidence: That I lied. That a woman who can't keep a marriage is not a good example for children.

facts.heading: Mum's influence on beliefs
facts.content: Jana's mother always said marriage is a thing and that it is what it is.
facts.evidence: She always said that marriage is a thing and that it's what it is.

facts.heading: Mum's reaction to Jana
facts.content: Jana's mother kept silent when Jana introduced her. The mother said she hopes Jana has been good to her.
facts.evidence: She kept silent. Then she said that she hopes I've been good to her.

facts.heading: Jana feels sad
facts.content: Jana feels sad and says she needs forgiveness. She expresses that it hurts and she doesn't want to be alone.
facts.evidence: Sad. I need you to forgive me. That it hurts, that I don't want to be alone, but that it doesn't work with us.

facts.heading: Jana cries when speaking
facts.content: Jana cries and apologizes when she says difficult things out loud. She finds it strange but helpful.
facts.evidence: I cry and I apologize. It's strange to sit here and say it all out loud. But it helps a little.

facts.heading: Jana's sleep attempts
facts.content: Jana has tried German tea for sleeping. She does not want to take the doctor's powder.
facts.evidence: German tea and that's all. Doctor offered me some powder, but I don't want to.

facts.heading: Fear of dependency
facts.content: Jana is afraid she won't be able to wake up for her children in time. She does not want to be dependent.
facts.evidence: I'm afraid I wouldn't be able to wake up for my children in time and I don't want to be dependent.

facts.heading: Patient's fear of panic
facts.content: Jana is afraid of panicking and crying. She is afraid of not being able to stay calm.
facts.evidence: That I'll panic and cry. That I won't be able to stay calm.

facts.heading: Desire for support
facts.content: Jana expressed a desire to feel not alone. She stated she does not have to do things right away.
facts.evidence: That I'm not alone and I don't have to do it right away.
